newsitem.title: POLAND: 66 road deaths as Poles visit family graves.
newsitem.headline: 66 road deaths as Poles visit family graves.

text.p: Sixty-six people died in road accidents over the All Saints Day holiday, mainly because Poles drove too fast on wet roads, police said.

Traffic inspector Grzegorz Turynski told Radio Zet 45 people died and 357 were injured on Thursday evening and 21 died and 215 were injured on Friday, the holiday on which many Poles visit family graves.
"The main cause of accidents has been excessive speed... inappropriate to wet and slippery road conditions", Turynski said.
